label: Diagram 3.5
caption: Diagram 3.5 Outward opening doors in a corner
description: This drawing presents three plan-view diagrams, labelled Figure 3.5A, 3.5B and 3.5C, illustrating outward opening doors arranged in a corner, the open space in each being marked "Circulation area". Figure 3.5A shows a corner wall with one door swinging out at the upper right and another at the bottom; a vertical dimension of 800mm is marked on the left wall between the two door leaves. Figure 3.5B shows a similar corner, with a horizontal dimension of 800mm across the top between two doors and a vertical dimension of 300mm on the left wall, the lower door swinging out into the area. Figure 3.5C depicts three doors around the corner, each with a swing arc, and a dashed circle drawn over the corner space; a diagonal dimension line across this circle is marked 1500mm. A footnote reads "*all dimensions are minimum except where noted". The bottom banner reads "Diagram 3.5 Outward opening doors in a corner".
